point_format: x base8, x eta-times-base8, y base8, y eta-times-base8; integer coefficients divided by96
selection_rule: Protect parent points in the whole frozen bridge. Let C be parent vertices adjacent to at least one new point. Repeatedly delete the unprotected remaining original vertex maximizing |N_remaining(v) intersect C|/max(1,degree_remaining(v)), breaking ties by least remaining degree then least label; delete k+1 originals for k new points. This is a deterministic heuristic, not an obstruction certificate.
